instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_021_three_plate_assembly.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file containing base_plate, spacer, and top_plate. The base_plate and top_plate are each 120 x 80 x 6 mm, and the spacer is 20 x 20 x 30 mm. Keep all three as independent parts. Move the spacer to the center on top of base_plate, then place top_plate on top of the spacer so the stack is vertical and all XY centers align. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_021_stack_assembly_out.step as an assembly or multi-body STEP retaining three independent solids, and write C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_021_massprops.txt containing assembly mass or volume properties. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). Run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_021_three_plate_assembly.step`.
